about: p95 budgets in ms, about 1.5x what was measured when each was set, and never looser than plan 042 began with. The browser suite (web/perf) and the server tests (internal/server) fail past them. On CI runners every budget is multiplied by ciMultiplier.

play-library.interaction: Play a song from the Library

play-library-cell.interaction: Play a song from the Library, clicking a cell

play-album.interaction: Play a song on its album page

heart-server.interaction: Heart a song, server round trip

open-album.interaction: Open an album from the Library

library-paint.interaction: Library first rows, from page load

scroll.interaction: Longest frame in a 2 s Library fling

rail-sweep.interaction: Longest frame while the Library sweeps the rail A to Z

play-shuffle.interaction: Shuffle the library, press to sound

sort-library.interaction: Turn the Library's order round, click to rows

track-change.interaction: A song ends, the next one sounds

album-change.interaction: An album ends, the next down the Library sounds

play-cover.interaction: Play an album from its cover

play-library-cover.interaction: Play an album from its Library cover

column-drag.interaction: Longest frame while dragging a column across the Library header, 2 s

column-drop.interaction: Drop a column, release to rows in their new order

column-key.interaction: Alt+→ on a column header, key to rows in their new order

stream-first-byte.interaction: Stream first byte, FLAC on local disk
